name: RustDesk
description: RustDesk is a remote desktop tool and an open-source alternative to TeamViewer. Self-host it on your own server with Dokploy, which deploys RustDesk as a Docker Compose service in a few clicks.
seoDescription: Open source remote desktop, an alternative to TeamViewer. Deploy RustDesk with Docker Compose on Dokploy in minutes – free, open source, self-hosted.
